notes.subject: נמשל/נדמו
notes.rationale: Paronomasia: 'he is likened' (נמשל) and 'they perish/are silenced' (נדמו) share the root consonants מ-ש-ל/ד-מ-ה assonance — the comparison and the destruction rhyme; lost in Maltese.

notes.subject: נדמו
notes.rationale: Root דמה means both 'be silent/dumb' and 'perish/be destroyed' — the beasts' dumbness and man's perishing are one word.

notes.subject: u / ma
notes.rationale: Conjunction and comparative particle supplied in Maltese to carry the relative and simile structure.

notes.subject: to the reader
notes.rationale: The psalm's wisdom refrain addresses the hearer directly with its closing verdict on the rich who lack understanding.

translation: Bniedem fi ġieħ ⟨u⟩ li ma jifhemx, tixbaħ ⟨ma⟩ l-bhejjem — huma nqatgħu.
